meta.demand_scale_note: D_i is normalized to average clean inferred rides per operating day. Boundary operating days are excluded when at least three observed days exist, because the first/last collection-window days are often partial.
meta.operator_move_filter_note: D_i and Origin-Destination Pair flows use only ride segments where excluded_from_demand is false. Segments flagged as likely operator moves are removed when speed > 28km/h, or speed > 25km/h with repeated fast moves, same Origin-Destination Pair/time clusters, or large battery delta.

method.regression_formula: log(1 + count_{day,hour,Origin-Destination Pair}) = alpha + hour_effect + origin_destination_pair_effect + error
method.regression_solver: balanced fixed-effect closed form over sparse Origin-Destination Pair/hour counts
method.calibration_note: Blended hourly Origin-Destination Pair rates use observed per-operating-day scale directly; they are not scaled to match optimization expected rides sum_i Q_i(x_i*).
method.norm_inv_note: Correlated standard-normal shocks Z are equivalent to applying NORM.INV/Phi^-1 to correlated uniform quantiles; demand uses Poisson(lambda_hat * exp(sigma Z - sigma^2/2)).
method.initial_inventory_rule: GCOO inventory starts from P*=x*, ALPACA inventory starts from latest snapshot, and both are pooled as available PM supply for combined market demand.
